releases.name: landstrip 0.20.0
releases.body:
Landstrip 0.20.0

landstrip:
- darwin: Carry log correlation tags through policy plumbing (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Report explicit read denials after successful exit (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- cli: Accept Unix socket paths for trap transport (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- config: Resolve executable policies relative to --cwd (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- doctor: Report supported filesystem tiers accurately (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- api: Support explicit literal and glob path selectors (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- docs: Update CLI subcommands and policy reference (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- policy: Deduplicate deny-rule queries and Windows root filters (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- config: Remove windows.backend shim and deduplicate loading (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- cli: Deduplicate argument types and CommandOutcome (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- cli: Fold capabilities into doctor report (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- windows: Load restricted user profile and isolate environment (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- windows: Support explicit allowRead and preserve deny roots (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- macos: Add Mach, Apple Events, and PTY policy controls (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- policy: Protect denied paths across moves, absent targets, and read globs (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- policy: Support literal and glob path selectors (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- network: Enforce Unix socket policy under allowNetwork (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- tests: Add integration tests for Linux namespaces and proc resolution (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Isolate sandboxed processes in user and PID namespaces (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- cli: Support working directory specification with --cwd (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- cli: Add capabilities command for feature discovery (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- cli: Require run subcommand for program execution (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- build: Codesign staged platform binaries on Darwin (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)
